[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29010070/4d42da512f7e171ae306229e5fcb90365c9ca26a.png[/img]

Here's some things you might have missed since 1.16:
[list]
[*] Patched in strafing for locomotion!
[*] Added in always-run (to be used with the aim-slowdown functionality (VR only for now).
[*] Some things that were still missing got zapped back into existence! 🌩

[*] Adding coins in Oculus should be less likely to fail if Oculus is being slow.

[*] Sodium should now ignite again when thrown into water.
[*] You can now see your experience and money even in the main menu! What's next, a working Inventory? 😮
[*] Many small tweaks and bug fixes
[/list]

For 1.21 we have:
[list]
[*] Bugs have been given a new color, which can sometimes help finding them! Also, submitting bug reports in-game should work more properly again.
[*] Fishies aren't so energetic on land.
[*] Double-barreled pop-gun will actually hit the targets on the lake now.
[*] Fixed players always getting the level up notification when entering the game (and occasionally being showered with gifts).
[*] Many items are now more usable in Mouse and Keyboard! Things like, the spray cans, sports balls, cameras, and many more can now be snapped into view with the F-key!
[*] A new item appears, the Sound Recorder Button, which lets you record a 15-second message!
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.15
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Hypatians![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29010070/ac43ccd0aa33812dcfd387362da3384c779b7b22.png[/img]

Update 1.15 is out now! We've done several updates in a row now, so lets take a moment to go over all the things that have changed in the last few updates!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29010070/500bc10de08776f34d0c40c809953f3458a175ce.png[/img]

[b]We fully support Mouse and Keyboard play![/b] Hypata is a VR first title, which means that some features may require the manual dexterity of VR in order to get the most out of them, but that is no reason to miss out on all the other features of Hypatia, or to not be able to play with your friends! 

So we've opened up Hypatia to all Steam users, regardless of having a VR headset or not. In order to do so, we've made a number of features more nonVR friendly, and added a HUD to display all the info you'll need, as well as helpful control reminders! Let us know what you think about these changes, we're always looking to improve it more.

VR users, don't worry! We haven't removed or changed any part from your experience to accommodate our new nonVR users, we just added some accessibility options to those without VR to simplify the controls.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29010070/b240fdfc9943837160c42306399f5213d31e7349.png[/img]

We now support Windows Mixed Reality headsets! We're always excited to support the latest hardware, and bring Hypatia to as many people as we can.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29010070/d9fc0c4e8048b6a0a064de51beedddb33ecd8528.png[/img]

Building your own property is one of the coolest parts of Hypatia! You can purchase a space using the in game currency, and then decorate it just the way you want, changing wallpapers, buying furniture, etc! There is personal property, where only you and people you invite can visit, and there are public property that you can decorate for anyone to come see!

We've recently added another purchasable hotel room, and made some [b]updates to the commercial property, and the apartment[/b] to add some more space to both!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29010070/1980807db3028ceb50dc020321e4dd230c6ca878.png[/img]

Missed the Lunar New Year event? That's okay! While the Spirit Hunt is no longer active, we've left the area open for exploration, and who knows what we'll put in there next!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29010070/248f4e37e8f4d861ed53219443c69e0381d2f713.jpg[/img]

Finally, in this latest update, we added in [b]new magic items - potions, orbs, and staves![/b] These fun consumable items are awarded from the daily login boxes, and provide things like speed boosts, extra bits (one of our in game currencies), or experience!

This new reward box will be awarded every day you login, and unlike previous temporary boxes, this box is not part of a timed event, and will continue to exist into the foreseeable future!

notes.title: Feature roadmap!

[b]Accessories[/b] are incoming as well! Like the current hats? Wish they followed your head, or stayed with you between areas? Want more accessories? Well you'll get all that and more!!

[b]Property[/b]
Ever wanted to have your own a private space in Hypatia for just you and your friends? What about renting an apartment and filling it with your favorite things? Wish you could own the door across from the Art Studio? Wanting to build an amusement park for all of Hypatia to enjoy? notes.title: Hypatia: Photos developed!
notes.content:
As promised in the last post, we'll be detailing our photo development process this week!

Players can take photos with a variety of different cameras in Hypatia, each camera with their own effects and qualities. Once you've taken the photo, what do you do with it?

Take your camera to the photography museum!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29010070/8870a4359ab470b8add0ce023cba1520e2304c48.png[/img]

The simpliest instructions
[olist]
[*]Insert camera
[*]Select photo
[*]Load your blank print
[*]Open the lamp
[*]Open the blocker
[/olist]

After a few seconds close the blocker, add chemicals and watch it develop right before your eyes!

But thats just the beginning. You can zoom, pan, and even color your photos. Try multiple exposures, or explosing different photos onto the same print!

Combine all of that with the various photography stations that help you setup nice shots for custom photos and you end up with such a variety of shots!

notes.title: Avatar Parts + Levels
notes.content:
[b]Hello Hypatians![/b]

Last week I promised we would discuss unlockable avatar parts, but before I give you the details on those, lets first get into HOW you unlock things in Hypatia.

[b]Hypatia now has levels and experience![/b]

No, Hyptia is not an RPG, and you do not have to grind through quests in order to advance. Instead, we award you experience while you play naturally. For instance, if you travel to a new area, it will say something like: "Discovered Techno Plaza" and award you a small amount of experience. 

As you continue to explore and experiment with Hypatia, you will eventually accumlate enough experience to reach your milestone and level up! Each time you level up you will get a gift box containing a variety of awards including  Avatar Parts!

So how do Avatar Parts Work? - When you first join Hypatia, you will only have a small handful of parts available to you, to build your avatar from. Through leveling and other gameplay you can unlock a multitude of diffrent parts. On top of that each and every part is customizable with multiple color settings per piece. We want to provide you with with the ability to truly express yourself within Hypatia, and new parts will be added all the time!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29010070/e3810da881490901182822aadadff8808c4b6229.gif[/img]

Stop by our communitiy forums and let us know what else you'd like to see out of the level system, or if there are any avatar parts you'd really love to have!


Next week we will discuss another large change to Hypatia - Currency!

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
Hello Hypatians! I hope your New Year has started off as well as ours has! We have some very good news to share with you, but first let's address the elephant in the room. 

The last patch was 4 months ago, with the last major update being an additional 2 months before that. In that time, I can assure you that we at Timefire VR have been working diligently towards the next stage of Hypatia. We've seen new and returning players log in, and even popped in to say hello a couple of times. Our fans mean the world to us, and your continued interest is why we’re still pushing forward.

So if we’re still here, why have we not said anything? There have been two major blockers on our communication. 

Due to outside financial changes, we had to downsize our development team to a more conservative size. This means content takes longer to complete, and we absolutely HATE promising things that we are not absolutely sure we can deliver on (meaning, if we don't have a realistic time estimate, we do not announce it).

Secondly, we WERE a publicly traded company. This means there was a lot of legal restrictions on what we could and could not say. This is where the good news comes in. Timefire has been bought out, but that’s a long and complicated history best told another day. The developers that are here are staying here, myself included. That means we’ll now have much greater freedom to share our development process with you.

But enough of history. What's next? We're filling in some key positions for our team, and ramping up for the next stage of Hypatia. We have a lot of awesome updates and additions which build upon the current foundation of Hypatia. Most of what needs to be done for this update is art content and bug-squashing. Currently, we’re estimating a late March release date.

I can’t spoil all of the fun details yet, but we do have two new areas, hundreds of items, significant new gameplay systems, and a large rework of some existing areas!

Stay tuned for upcoming details about Hypatia: Grand Opening, including a more in depth look at the upcoming changes!

notes.title: Update v1.0.114
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Hypatians![/h1]

This update adds a number of requested features including movement options, friend summoning, inventory upgrades and more! 

The next major update will be focused on releasing the demo, avatar upgrades, and everything else described in our previous blog post that we haven’t gotten to yet. 
Blog post: http://timefirevr.com/2017/06/23/hypatia-news-horizon/

[h1]Changelist V1.0.114[/h1]
Added
[list]
[*] Movement aiming mode! You can now choose between head aiming and hand aiming modes. These aiming modes work with every movement mode (Locomotion, Teleport & Step). Hand aiming is the new default control option. 
[*] Inventory storage has been added. In Centrum, and Centrum South, you will find ATM Kiosks that allow you to transfer items between your backpack and storage
[*] Friend summoning! You can use the social menu to summon a friend to your location.
[*] Maps have been added to both Centrum and Centrum South
[*] A proper settings menu for controls, graphics, and voice. This will be updated with more settings and setting descriptions over time.
[/list]
Updated
[list]
[*] Anti aliasing option updated for MSAA (Now has Off, Low, and High settings only)
[*] Player Notifications will now use the HMD layer to display
[*] Voice menu moved into social menu
[*] Menus will properly close or follow you as you move away. (depending on menu type)
[*] 2D paintings on paintable surfaces will now reload up on server start, which makes 2D painting entirely persistent
[*] Updated hand states + animations
[*] Oculus: A/X Button are now the confirm buttons for the context menu. (Previously thumbstick pressed)
[*] Oculus: Default grip setting is now hold (Previous Toggle)
[/list]
Fixed
[list]
[*] Main menu, character creator, and quit game transitions properly fade out now.
[*] Performance updates and tweaks
[*] Various bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.0.107 and short term road map!
notes.content:
This is a pretty significant update with quite a few things to look at. First of all we’ve changed our shading model, which means the world will no longer be blurry at a distance. This is a major visual update and it does cause some occasional graphical issues, but we’ll be actively working on fixing all of those as we go forward. If you find something we’ve overlooked please let us know at support@timefirevr.com
 
We’ve also fixed a pretty large bug that had been plaguing us - your hand should no longer get “stuck” if you rapidly pick up an object.
 
Additionally, we’ve been reviewing everyone's feedback from Steam, Reddit, and in-world conversations. While we can’t talk about specific feature and additions (like new levels!) that are still a ways out, we would like to talk about what we’re working on now, that we can guarantee will be released in the near future. Upcoming features include new movement options, a map, inventory & avatar features and more!

You can get all the details here: http://timefirevr.com/category/hypatia-news/

[h1]v1.0.107 Patch notes[/h1]

Updated
[list]
[*]Switched shading mode so that the world will no longer appear blurry at further distances
[*]Increased the Screen Percentage range from 100-130 to 100-170. We recommend that only computers with top of the line graphics cards go above 130.
[*]Increased default item cap from 1 to 2.
[/list]
Fixed
[list]
[*]Fixed the issue where your hand could disappear if you grabbed an item repeatedly
[*]Fixed the issue with the “void” not resolving you on the proper side of the wall you walked through
[*]Context menu titles should now display properly
[*]Loading screens should now work properly on both Vive and Oculus!
[*]Servers should now be reused more often, resulting in paintings being preserved for longer
[*]Fixed an issue where you would see the player’s hand while they are holding an object if you joined after they picked it up.
[*]Fixed the elevator that was clipping through walls in the Cogwheel Garden
[*]Fixed a crash in Boat Racing relating to the scoreboard.
[*]Making a 3D painting mesh “Live” now properly accounts for the energy cost (and displays the cost on the menu)
[*]Various sound updates
[*]Fixed painting canvases lock feature. (Prevents the painting from being painted on further)
[*]Improved the rotation of an arriving player after a map change. This is still a work in progress.

notes.title: Update: v1.0.102
notes.content:
The login/account creation process has been extremely simplified! We have removed the verification button, as this feature does not currently offer a lot of benefit and its current implementation was just causing confusion. Accounts are now ready to play as soon as they create a character. Finally, new players will immediately load into the character creator.


[b]Patch notes[/b]

Updated
[list]
[*]Streamlined login process by removing verification and starting new players directly in the character creator.
[*]Polaroid style photos are now tracked as part of your maximum item count (no more infinite pictures on the ground)
[*]Various sound balances
[*]Nameplate positioning now adjusts based on your height.
[*]Changing character name now has a cancel button
[/list]

Fixed
[list]
[*]Fixed a recently introduced crash on startup without internet
[*]Fixed an intermittent client crash in the art studio
[*]Live meshes will now properly refund energy upon deletion
[*]Fixed the fireworks cap sometimes snapping to the incorrect position
[*]Minor texture fixes
[*]Fix for invalid player names remaining in the friends list (Incorrectly reported as part of last fix)
[*]Fixed friends status not properly updating for both players immediately (Incorrectly reported as part of last fix)
[*]Fixed occasionally seeing two shadows for your hands (Incorrectly reported as part of last fix)
[*]Fixed incorrect painting on some surfaces in Paintville and the Art Studio
[*]Players in teleport mode who are in the boat race will now properly teleport off the boat at the end of the race.
[*]Navigation fixes in Museum De Kurio
[*]Scoreboard at end of boat race will now display your time properly
[*]You will now see your own nameplate in photos you take
[*]The sharing type menu button for 3D paint meshes will now open the proper sub-menu
[*]Fixes bug where clicking yes in friends list doesn't actually add them to the friends list visuals right away. 
[*]Fixes bug where accepting friend requests in the main menu resulted in a duplicate entry in the friends list. 
[*]Group chats will now properly clear on logging out of the voice service
[*]Fixed server gate in Centrum South
[*]Fixed “Toggle” grabbing mode
[*]Fixed a bug where painted surfaces would reset on being painted on
[*]Window sill in Art studio is now paintable
[*]In Mango Plaza photos meeting multiple requirements on the checklist will now check multiple requirements!

notes.title: Welcome to Hypatia!
notes.content:
Hypatia is a multi-player social VR app that encourages creativity and exploration on a global scale. Take a walk and chat with friends on the streets of our city, discover our immersive museums where you can become part of the art. Uncover secrets and unlock treasures through our puzzles. Create 3D and 2D masterpieces on the streets or in the city of Paintville. Create your own fireworks where you might also learn something about the science of how they work. Or get on stage with magic props before you head over to the waterfront to grab a rowboat for a Ride Down a canal that will have you feeling like you are right there in Amsterdam. Keep in mind that this is only the beginning. We will be adding new neighborhoods, shopping, apartments, and a lot more content as the city of Hypatia grows.

Become a founding citizen of Hypatia, help shape the city of the future and unlock its global potential. We are looking forward to meeting you, virtually!
